# `grp_setup()`

For quick setup, run the `grp_setup()` function to create `changelog.md`, `LICENSE`, `CITATION` and `requirements.md` files.

```{r grp_setup, echo=FALSE, eval=TRUE, out.width='100%'}
knitr::include_graphics("../man/figures/grp_setup.png")
```
